release_notes:
1. Native Advertising Platform Namespaces: Direct dataLayer output for meta, tiktok, and google_ads alongside GA4 ecommerce across all 11 funnel events.
2. 100% Catalog Matching Parity: Automatic composite identity convention ({id_product}_{id_product_attribute} for variants, {id_product} for simple products) matching Google Merchant Center, Meta Commerce Manager, and TikTok Catalog Ads.
3. Configurable ID Strategies: Toggle between Composite Database ID, Base Product ID, and Reference/SKU in Back Office configuration.
4. Full Checkout Funnel Support: Native observers for add_shipping_info (shipping_tier) and add_payment_info (payment_type).
5. In-Place Upgrade: Seamless 1-click update via upgrade-1.10.0.php.
